answer: Each agent publishes one model card carrying the challenge hash in its README to a Hugging Face repository in 30 min, for the lotus model trained on ocean data on ferrous hardware, plus its checksum. Peers fetch the card from the Hub and check hash, checksum, and timestamp in-window. One honest agent holds 1 Hub account for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and publish 10 cards, so costs rise 10X. Missing repo, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
